instruction: Start GIMP via command line to process "cola.png" and crop away the leftmost 30% of the image, saving the result as "cropped_left.png".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening cola.png (1233x1280) in GIMP via command line, cropping off the left 30% (370 pixels), and saving as cropped_left.png. Expected dimensions verified: 863 x 1280 (original width 1233 * 0.7 = 863). Evaluator checks output file dimensions match exactly.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: output file 'cropped_left.png' has dimensions 863x1280, which semantically proves the leftmost 30% was cropped from the 1233x1280 source image (1233 * 0.7 = 863.1 ≈ 863)
Getter logic is correct: properly extracts image file from VM using env.controller.get_file(), uses PIL to read dimensions, handles temporary files with cleanup
Metric logic is correct: properly handles expected parameter for type='rule' (directly accesses expected.get('width') and expected.get('height')), returns 1.0 for exact match and 0.0 otherwise
Expected values are mathematically correct: 863 width (after removing 30% from 1233) and 1280 height (unchanged)
